capabilities.name: create_run

capabilities.name: plan_run
capabilities.description: Generate a deterministic or explicit tool plan using planner.py with metadata tracking.

capabilities.name: execute_run
capabilities.description: Full execute loop: context, intent routing, evidence planning, tool execution, adaptive expansion, governance, finalization, tracing.

capabilities.name: pause_run
capabilities.description: Set run status to paused and checkpoint.

capabilities.description: Set run status to running and checkpoint.

capabilities.name: cancel_run
capabilities.description: Set run status to cancelled and checkpoint.

capabilities.name: get_trace
